image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a rooster (cock) standing on dirt ground. The bird features vibrant golden-orange hackle and saddle feathers, with black tail feathers showing some iridescence. It has a prominent red comb and wattles. A blue object, likely a person's leg in jeans, is visible in the bottom right foreground, partially obscuring the view.
